sql: SELECT t.team_name, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM caseflow.calendar WHERE is_working_day AND day BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-30'), 1) AS per_working_day FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id JOIN caseflow.teams t ON t.team_id = c.team_id WHERE d.reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND d.reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY t.team_name
explanation: Documents reviewed in October 2026 by each team, per working day up to 30 October.
assumptions: October 2026 has 22 working days to the 30th
